item.title: Interview: ITU’s Dr. Cosmas Luckyson Zavazava on Connecting the Remaining Two Billion
item.summary: Bridging the digital divide remains one of the defining challenges for the telecom sector, particularly across the Asia Pacific’s diverse mix of small island states, landlocked economies, and rapidly digitizing urban centers. In an exclusive interview with Telecom Review Asia, Dr. Cosmas Luckyson Zavazava, Director of the Telecommunication Development Bureau (BDT) at the International Te​lecommunication Union […] The post Interview: ITU’s Dr. Cosmas Luckyson Zavazava on Connecting the Remaining Two Billion appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
